GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( w, Tongue Tie & ear muffs off ) jumped fine Wide out. Crossed in Two Wide 8th 6 Lengths @ 700m. Ridden Along into Straight all Clear . wound up well. Just missed # ran on well

Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed out Four Wide @ 450m & held up slightly 3 Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & ran on solidly in last 150m. # Shade unlucky.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped with a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Ridden Along however no speed settled down third last fence 9 Lengths (1400m), shuffled back last well before Turn , Straightened Up to the Outside with room to run on 5 Lengths away 300 Under Whip , did keep coming Without threat (Blinkers OFF AGAIN, Ear Muffs FIRST TIME, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF FIRST TIME, Winkers AGAIN) # bled/3 month ban
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Bled 1st time-banned from racing for 3 months. Galloped satisfactorily.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: no rush from the gate settled down second last Two Wide 6 Lengths (1200m), improved a length to 500, Under Whip Straight not making any Further Ground , lost Ground final 200 # never close
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Severely hampered after the start and lost ground when tightened between PRIZE WITNESS and TSZUYA. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: let drift right back off the Wide gate settled a Clear last 11 Lengths (1000m), still last To The Turn , Straightened Up with plenty to do, did make Ground & with very little room # last/made ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up for clear running over the final 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: No rush from the gate settled down in final few 9 Lengths from the lead (800m), stayed rail Saved Ground into the Straight still plenty to do though & not doing it, no run on (jockey reported the mare did not feel right in its action when pulling up. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities) # back/no factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mare did not feel right in its action when pulling up. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: No rush off the Wide alley before Quickly improved to settle 6 Lengths off the lead racing alone (700m), Ridden Along Turn & into the Straight trying to make Ground , couldn't (Bandages (Front) OFF FIRST TIME, Blinkers AGAIN, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # couldn't run on
Bit Slow Out Ridden Along Drifted Back Settled Down 5th Inside 4 Lengths Couldn'T Go On @ 600m, # cardiac arrhythmia
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to weaken on entering the home straight. Rdr reported concerned with action of mare upon straightening & elected not to place under pressure for the remainder. A post-race vet exam revealed cardiac arrythmia. Vet clearance, with ECG results & satisfactory cardiac auscultation vet report post gallop of at least 1000m required prior to being permitted to race again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok ? Ridden Along Went Forward sat 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths with 1st following race very much run to suit , Turning for home mid of 3 under riding and now with winner Outside it, dueled to line, was # just No Match
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground in straight. (Equicast OFF FIRST TIME) # unthreatening 3rd

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn , Held Up home turn and blocked in straight, unable to shoulder clear then switched back and gained a narrow rails run inside the 200m, kept coming to post. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME, Winkers FIRST TIME) # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: At the entrance to the straight became held up on heels and was unable to be fully tested until improving into a narrow run passing the 150m.
